evals.expected_output: The agent takes a baseline dump, delegates classification to one Sonnet worker, runs a live freshness pass, presents review.md at gate 1, writes notes and gists through workers, verifies them, presents reorg.md at gate 2, applies the layout, diffs the dump, commits with a dated message and asks before pushing.
assertions: Runs dump.ts before any vault edit and again after apply.ts, and explains every lost URL
Hands the classifier brief to a single worker told to run in the foreground
Runs the freshness brief with web search on every extract and link + gist row before gate 1
Shows review.md as a link and takes flips in the `12 → link` form before any note is written
Every note has frontmatter source, fetched, status, no # heading, and a body from the page text
Every non-extract line ends with ` — gist` under 15 words
Presents reorg.md as before/after with cross-file targets checked against the target file's headings
Runs wikilinks.ts on every edited file and reports 0 unresolved
Commits as `YYYY-MM-DD notes: <topic>` and asks push now or review first
